svg.title: Allowed exposure time falls as dBA rises
svg.desc: A curve of daily allowed exposure time against sound level from 85 to 100 dBA, marking 3 h 34 min at 88.5, 1 h 47 min at 91.5 and 53 min at 94.5 dBA.
